title: MedDINOv3: How to adapt vision foundation models for medical image segmentation?
mechanism: Plain ViT with multi-scale token aggregation for segmentation plus multi-stage domain-adaptive DINOv3 pretraining on 3.87M CT slices.
evidence: R (abstract): matches or exceeds SOTA on four CT/MRI segmentation benchmarks.
adaptation: Use its multi-scale token aggregation as the VFM-H fusion design; run its domain-adaptive DINOv3 recipe on the 159k EL pool only if ExPLoRA shows an E1 sign (159k is 4% of their data).
min_experiment: Fusion design swap in VFM-H vs simple projection; CV crack relF1@2 and E1 relF1@2; kill if less than +0.01 on either.
prior_overlap: No ViT domain-adaptive pretraining was run; ResNet MIM is a different objective. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: Continue DINOv3 ViT-B/16 SSL on the 11.9k pool (or the 159k pool if download approved) at 512-1024 px, then plug into the Dino U-Net harness.
alt_notes.min_experiment: EL-continued DINOv3 vs natural DINOv3 in the same Dino U-Net harness; kill if E1 crack relF1@2 gain < 0.02 and CV crack relF1@2 not better.

alt_notes.adaptation: Step 1: multi-scale aggregation + 512-768 px on DINOv3 ViT-B, no pretraining change. Step 2: the 3-stage recipe on the de-duplicated pool, stage 3 with 512-768 crops.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Step 2 vs step 1, 2 seeds, out-of-fold relF1@2 and E1 crack recall. Kill step 2 if < +0.01 and < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Step 1: multi-scale aggregation + 512 to 768 px on DINOv3 ViT-B, no pretraining change. Step 2: continued pretraining on the de-duplicated pool.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Step 2 vs step 1; kill step 2 if < +0.01 out-of-fold relF1@2 and < +0.02 E1 recall.
